title: User Login Success with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in with valid username and password and receive a valid access token.

steps.description: Navigate to the Authentication Form.
Input a registered username and correct password.
Submit the login form.
Verify that the backend returns a valid access token.
Verify the user session is established and dashboard page is displayed.

title: User Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Check that login fails with incorrect username or password and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the Authentication Form.
Input an invalid username or incorrect password.
Submit the login form.
Verify an error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed.
Verify no access token is issued and user remains on login form.

title: User Logout Clears Session and Redirects to Login
description: Validate that logging out successfully terminates the session and redirects to the authentication form.

steps.description: Log in successfully with valid credentials.
Click the logout button in the Navigation Bar.
Verify the access token is revoked and removed from client storage.
Verify the user is redirected to the login page.

title: CSV Upload Successful on Web and Desktop
description: Ensure users can upload valid chemical equipment CSV files in both Web and Desktop interfaces and receive success confirmation.

steps.description: Authenticate and navigate to the CSV Upload Panel.
Select a valid CSV file with equipment parameters (Equipment Name, Type, Flowrate, Pressure, Temperature).
Upload the selected CSV file.
Verify the backend processes the file without errors.
Verify the client shows a successful upload message.

title: CSV Upload Failure with Invalid Format
description: Check the system properly handles CSV file uploads with missing required columns or invalid file format by showing errors.

steps.description: Authenticate and navigate to the CSV Upload Panel.
Select a CSV file missing one or more required columns or an unsupported file type.
Attempt to upload the file.
Verify an error message is displayed describing invalid format or missing fields.
Verify the upload is rejected and no dataset history is updated.

title: Display Accurate Data Summary Cards After Upload
description: Validate that after a CSV upload, the dashboard shows correct total counts, average values, and equipment type distributions consistent with backend data.

steps.description: Upload a valid CSV dataset and wait for processing.
Navigate to the Dashboard.
Verify summary cards display the correct total equipment count.
Verify average metrics for Flowrate, Pressure, and Temperature match backend summary.
Verify type distribution chart matches API data and visualization is correct.

title: Persist and Display Last 5 Uploaded Dataset History Correctly
description: Confirm that the application stores the last five uploaded datasets and displays their details accurately in the history table.

steps.description: Upload six different valid CSV datasets sequentially.
Navigate to the History UI panel.
Verify only the latest five datasets are listed.
Verify dataset details (upload timestamp, summary statistics) are accurate and correspond to backend data.
Verify older dataset (the first uploaded) is no longer present in the history.

title: Charts Render Correctly on Web and Desktop
description: Ensure type distribution charts and metric visualization charts render accurately using Chart.js (Web) and Matplotlib (Desktop) consistently.

steps.description: Upload a CSV dataset and allow processing.
On Web, navigate to dashboard and check charts.
Verify Chart.js charts display correct dataset distributions and values.
On Desktop, open the corresponding dashboard.
Verify Matplotlib charts display accurate and matching visualizations.

title: Token-Based Session Persistence Across User Sessions
description: Check that after login, the access token persists correctly to allow continued authenticated API calls and that session is maintained across page reloads.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials and obtain token.
Reload the web application or restart desktop app.
Verify the token is valid and session remains active without prompting for login again.
Perform authenticated API calls (data fetch, upload etc.) using persisted token.
Verify API calls succeed and user remains authorized.

title: PDF Report Generation for Selected Dataset
description: Validate the functionality to generate downloadable PDF reports containing dataset analyses is working correctly for any selected dataset without errors.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to a detailed view of a previously uploaded dataset.
Trigger the PDF report generation action.
Verify a PDF file is generated and download is initiated.
Open the PDF and confirm it contains accurate dataset summaries, charts, and correctly formatted data.

title: UI Elements React Correctly to User Inputs and Navigation
description: Check that UI components such as navigation links highlight correctly, buttons respond to clicks, and forms validate inputs properly.

steps.description: Navigate through the app pages via the Navigation Bar.
Verify active link highlighting updates correctly for each visited page.
Enter invalid data in forms (e.g. login, upload) and attempt submission.
Verify forms show appropriate validation messages and prevent invalid submissions.
Interact with buttons such as logout, upload, generate report.
Verify buttons perform their expected actions with visible feedback.

title: Handling API Errors Gracefully
description: Verify that the frontend gracefully handles backend API failures such as network errors, invalid responses, or server errors without crashing.

steps.description: Simulate backend API failures (e.g. disconnect network, force 500 errors).
Perform typical operations including login, dataset upload, data fetch.
Verify the frontend shows meaningful error messages to the user.
Verify the application UI remains responsive and stable with no crashes or unhandled exceptions.

title: Restrict Access to Protected Routes Without Authentication
description: Confirm that navigation guards prevent unauthenticated users from accessing dashboard, upload panel, or history pages, redirecting them to login form.

steps.description: Attempt to navigate directly to protected URLs without logging in.
Verify redirection to the Authentication Form occurs automatically.
Attempt API calls requiring authorization without valid token.
Verify the calls are rejected and unauthorized error responses returned.
